description: Current facts a model cannot know from training, each with sources compared and as_of: POST /v1/time, /v1/holidays, /v1/business-days, /v1/fx (central-bank rates), /v1/weather, /v1/fact (current Wikidata statements), /v1/news and /v1/jobs, and get one JSON object with the answer, the agreeing and disagreeing sources and how fresh each is. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.
